valuation_reconciliation.explanation: 24 active non-dash Portfolio Statement rows sum exactly to S$23.702305b. ION Orchard and CapitaSpring are included as active portfolio/JV property rows from card pages because the report discloses them in operations/Portfolio Valuation, but they are absent from the audited investment-property Portfolio Statement. 21 Collyer Quay is preserved as divested with null FY2024 market_valuation because the Portfolio Statement shows a dash after disposal.

portfolio_value_cross_check.basis: proportionate interests, includes ION Orchard 50%, CapitaSpring 45%, CapitaSky 70%, Gallileo/Main Airport Center 94.9%, 101-103 Miller & Greenwood Plaza 50%; excludes 21 Collyer Quay divested 11 Nov 2024
portfolio_value_cross_check.not_used_as_market_valuation: Marketing/proportionate table is not the audited Tier-C source for consolidated investment properties; stored only in row alt_value/alt_basis where material.

columns_never_fillable.evidence: Per-property NPI is NOT disclosed anywhere, including for the equity-accounted JV rows. Financial-review by-property table (page 23) lists Gross Revenue per property only (FY2023 & FY2024). Note 31 Operating Segments (pages 182-183) discloses NPI only at the 3 reportable-segment level: Retail S$420,146k, Office S$387,646k, Integrated Developments S$345,686k (Group S$1,153,478k) and excludes joint ventures entirely (single unallocated line 'share of results (net of tax) of joint ventures' S$33,756k). Segment charts (page 24) repeat the same 3 segment NPIs. Property cards (pages 38-63) disclose Gross Revenue but no per-property NPI. JV note check (Note 7 Joint Ventures, pages 139-141) for the equity-accounted rows ION Orchard (OTH Group, 50%) and CapitaSpring (GOT/GSRT, 45%): the material-JV summary discloses only gross revenue (OTH Group S$46,761k; GOT S$102,128k) and total return for the year (OTH Group S$15,634k; GOT S$82,244k) on a 100% JV-entity basis, plus the Group's share of total return (OTH Group S$(10,299)k; GOT S$37,142k) - NO net property income line is disclosed for any JV, so attributable NPI cannot be sourced and stays null (row flags document this). Prior citation of pages 176-177 for the segment note corrected to 182-183 (176-177 is the Financial Risk/Fair Value note). Verified same treatment as FY2025.
No per-property share-of-NPI percentage disclosed; NPI is only broken down by the 3 reportable segments (page 24 / Note 31), not by property, so a per-property npi_pct cannot be sourced.
Property cards disclose Gross Floor Area and/or Net Lettable Area; no Gross Lettable Area field is printed. gfa/nla populated instead.

Genuinely absent for the Australian assets 100 Arthur Street (p57), 66 Goulburn Street (p56) and 101-103 Miller Street & Greenwood Plaza (p63): their cards print Net Lettable Area only, with no Gross Floor Area row. All Singapore/Germany cards do disclose GFA and it is populated. 21 Collyer Quay was divested before year-end and has no FY2024 card, so gfa/nla/occupancy are absent.

Only 66 Goulburn Street prints an explicit lease expiry date ('Leasehold expiring 16 August 2116', p56) -> filled 2116-08-16. All other leasehold assets disclose only 'with effect from <date>' plus a term (in tenure_raw) and a Portfolio Statement remaining term; no explicit expiry date is printed, so lease_expiry_date is left null rather than computed.

Land-lease commencement ('with effect from <date>') is disclosed on the cards but captured verbatim in tenure_raw per the extractor convention (both FY2024 and FY2025 leave the structured effective_date null); not separately parsed to avoid a divergent convention.

Null only for freehold assets (Plaza Singapura, 100 Arthur Street, 101-103 Miller & Greenwood Plaza, Gallileo, Main Airport Center — no land-lease term) and for 66 Goulburn Street, whose Portfolio Statement term is disclosed as a range '111-125 years' (tenure_raw), not a single value; its lease_expiry_date (2116-08-16) is captured instead.
Major tenant lists on pages 38-63 name tenants and state the ranking basis, but do not disclose per-tenant percentages.

parsing_traps: Use audited Portfolio Statement page 107 S$'000 values for market_valuation; do not use page 21-22 marketing Portfolio Valuation except as proportionate alt basis.
CapitaSky, Gallileo and Main Airport Center have partial ownership but audited values are 100% consolidated; row flags document NCI/partial ownership.
ION Orchard and CapitaSpring are active JV/equity-accounted properties disclosed on card pages but absent from the audited investment-property table; row flags document source and basis.
21 Collyer Quay was divested 11 Nov 2024; do not carry forward 2023 Portfolio Statement value. Transaction captured separately.
Bugis+ and Bukit Panjang Plaza share the disclosed Other Assets gross revenue/occupancy line; gross_revenue left null for both to avoid double-counting.
Gallileo gross revenue is N.M. due to AEI and is left null rather than zero.
Foreign card values disclose EUR/AUD local values and SGD translations; audited market_valuation remains SGD from page 107, local card values stored as original_currency/original_value where printed.
